steps.title: Automated Secret Detection & Pre-Commit Scanner
steps.description: Build an automated regex secret scanner that detects accidental AWS access keys, GitHub personal access tokens, and private RSA keys in source code.
tasks: Create `/home/student/scan_secrets.sh`
Implement scanning patterns for AWS keys (`AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}`), Private Keys (`BEGIN.*PRIVATE KEY`), and Bearer tokens
Make it exit with status 1 if secrets are found, and 0 if clean
Test running the scanner on `/home/student/`

verification.command: test -x /home/student/scan_secrets.sh && grep -q 'AKIA' /home/student/scan_secrets.sh && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Hardened Multi-Stage Dockerfile (Non-Root User)
steps.description: Construct a production-hardened Dockerfile implementing multi-stage build, minimal Alpine base image, and dedicated non-root UID 10001 execution.
tasks: Create `/home/student/Dockerfile.secure`
Use multi-stage pattern: `FROM node:18-alpine AS builder` and `FROM alpine:3.19` runtime
Add a non-root system user: `RUN addgroup -S appgroup && adduser -S appuser -G appgroup -u 10001`
Specify `USER 10001` to prevent container root privilege escalation

verification.command: test -f /home/student/Dockerfile.secure && grep -q 'USER' /home/student/Dockerfile.secure && grep -q 'adduser' /home/student/Dockerfile.secure && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) & Vulnerability Audit
steps.description: Generate a JSON Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) for an application dependencies tree to ensure supply chain integrity (SLSA compliance).
tasks: Create sample `/home/student/package.json` with dependencies like `express` and `jsonwebtoken`
Write `/home/student/generate_sbom.sh` to extract package names, exact versions, and SHA-256 integrity hashes into `/home/student/sbom.json`
Execute `/home/student/generate_sbom.sh` and inspect `/home/student/sbom.json`

verification.command: test -x /home/student/generate_sbom.sh && /home/student/generate_sbom.sh && test -f /home/student/sbom.json && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: X.509 SSL/TLS Certificate Validator
steps.description: Write a cryptographic audit script that inspects TLS certificates, verifies validity dates, and alerts if certificate expires within 30 days.
tasks: Generate a self-signed test certificate: `openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -keyout /home/student/server.key -out /home/student/server.crt -days 365 -nodes -subj '/CN=opsacademy.local'`
Write `/home/student/verify_cert.sh` that uses `openssl x509 -enddate -noout -in /home/student/server.crt`
Make the script output the expiration date and return PASS

verification.command: test -f /home/student/server.crt && test -x /home/student/verify_cert.sh && /home/student/verify_cert.sh && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Linux Kernel & Sysctl Hardening Audit
steps.description: Audit and harden kernel network parameters to protect against SYN flood attacks and IP spoofing.
tasks: Create `/home/student/sysctl_hardening.conf`
Add recommendations for `net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies = 1`
Add `net.ipv4.conf.all.rp_filter = 1` (reverse path filtering against IP spoofing)
Add `net.ipv4.icmp_echo_ignore_broadcasts = 1`

verification.command: test -f /home/student/sysctl_hardening.conf && grep -q 'tcp_syncookies' /home/student/sysctl_hardening.conf && grep -q 'rp_filter' /home/student/sysctl_hardening.conf && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: File Capability & SUID/SGID Privilege Auditing
steps.description: Hunt for unsafe SUID/SGID binaries in the filesystem that could allow unprivileged users to escalate to root.
tasks: Write an audit script `/home/student/audit_suid.sh`
Use `find / -perm -4000 -type f 2>/dev/null` or `find /usr/bin -perm -4000 2>/dev/null` to identify SUID binaries
Redirect output to `/home/student/suid_audit_report.txt`
Execute the audit script

verification.command: test -x /home/student/audit_suid.sh && /home/student/audit_suid.sh && test -f /home/student/suid_audit_report.txt && echo PASS || echo FAIL
